clauses.title: Scope – Covers the
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Covers the material, dimensions and sectional properties of aluminium tee - sections  for structural use and other applications.

clauses.title: Designation – Aluminium tee-sections  shall be
clauses.text: 2. Designation - Aluminium tee-sections  shall be designated as ALT  followed  by the depth of section, in mm  width of flange in  mm and mass in kilograms per metre of the section. Example :  ALT 125 × 100 - 7.0

clauses.title: Aluminium sections
clauses.text: 3.1 Aluminium sections  covered in this standard shall be manufactured from the following alloys in appropriate temper - 19000, 24345, 24534, 52000, 53000, 54300, 63400, 64423, 64430, 65032 and 74530.

clauses.title: Aluminium alloys and temper selected shall
clauses.text: 3.2 Aluminium alloys and temper selected shall conform to the proviions of IS 733 : 1983+ + Wrought  aluminium and aluminium  alloy, bars, rods and sections for general engineering purposes (third revision) SUMMARY OF IS 6445 : 1985  ALUMINIUM TEE - SECTIONS (First Revision)
